extraTaxes.name: Mokestis už aplinkos teršimą pakuočių atliekomis
extraTaxes.summary: Environmental pollution tax on packaging waste. Producers/importers are EXEMPT for the share of packaging that is actually recycled (in practice via a PRO such as Gamtos ateitis or Žaliasis taškas); the tax is effectively the penalty on the unmanaged share. Statutory rates (from 2025, reusable + recyclable single-use packaging, EUR/t): glass 279, plastic/PET 520, paper/cardboard 133, metal 186, wood 189, composite 520. Non-recyclable single-use is higher: glass 395, plastic 875, paper 188, metal 263, wood 225, composite 1200 EUR/t. The base rate is multiplied by an annual indexing coefficient (1.48 for 2026). Fetched from Gamtos ateitis legal-info page 2026-08-16.
extraTaxes.rate: recyclable packaging EUR/t (×1.48 index for 2026): plastic 520, glass 279, paper 133, metal 186, wood 189, composite 520

notes: pro.rates left null: the figures above are the statutory pollution-TAX rates (the penalty/alternative to PRO compliance), not a PRO's own per-material management fee (tvarkymo įkainiai), which PROs price by contract. Compliance route: register in GPAIS (mandatory even at tiny volumes) and contract a licensed PRO (Gamtos ateitis, Žaliasis taškas) to recycle and thereby gain the tax exemption. From 2025 obligations can only be met by recycling (incineration no longer counts).
